escapism.h2: A Café Made for a Little Escapism
paras: Step into a sweet escape from the ordinary. Wand & Whisk Café is a locally owned dessert atelier serving handcrafted Japanese-inspired crepes, taiyaki soft serve, fluffy soufflé pancakes, and colorful potion sodas in a whimsical café setting.
Whether you’re stopping in for a signature dessert, a playful drink, or a little everyday magic, Wand & Whisk is designed to feel like a magical bubble away from the outside world.

a: Wand & Whisk Café is a Japanese-inspired dessert and luxury ice cream café in Little Rock, Arkansas, built for fans of anime, tabletop games, trading cards, fantasy, and video games. It serves taiyaki, rolled Japanese crepes, soufflé pancakes, and potion sodas.

faq.q: Where is Wand & Whisk Café located?
a: We’re located in the Outlets of Little Rock in Little Rock, Arkansas. You’ll find us across from Otaku Takeout and the Lucky Cat Arcade. We’re also right next to The Dojo, a TTRPG gaming and trading card store. If you’re trying to get directions for your GPS, though, here’s our address:

11201 Bass Pro Pkwy Suite M147
Little Rock, AR 72210

faq.q: What makes your ice cream different from regular soft serve?
a: Our soft serve is real milk cream at 12.5% milk fat, which meets the USDA standard for actual ice cream and runs about double what you’ll find elsewhere in Arkansas. It’s crafted in-house under our Head Chef and benchmarked against Japan’s luxury soft serve tradition.

faq.q: Do you host birthday parties or group events?
a: Yes. The café is designed for celebrating the things you love, so birthdays and group meetups are a natural fit. Watch the Events section for tastings, themed experiences, and seasonal drops.

Pre-ordering items is required for private buyouts (72 hours notice) and highly encouraged for large tables to maintain kitchen pacing and fresh service.
An automatic 18% service gratuity is applied to group tabs of 10 or more guests to support our dedicated Guild team members.

about.title: About Us | Wand & Whisk Café, Little Rock
about.description: Wand & Whisk Café is a locally owned dessert café in Little Rock, Arkansas, created for people who believe dessert should feel like an experience.

intro.h2: Wand & Whisk Café: A Little Magic for Little Rock
paras: Wand & Whisk Café is a locally owned dessert café in Little Rock, Arkansas, created for people who believe dessert should feel like an experience.

Inspired by Japanese desserts and the warmth and wonder of a magical guild, Wand & Whisk offers a little escape from the ordinary. Come celebrate a birthday, meet friends who share your interests, enjoy dessert with your family, or simply settle into a welcoming space designed to feel playful, comforting, and a little otherworldly.

Our world draws inspiration from magical girls anime, tabletop games, trading card games, fantasy novels, and video games, but all you need is an appetite and a willingness to believe an ordinary day can still hold a little magic to join the guild!

softServe.h2: Luxury Soft Serve Ice Cream in Little Rock, Arkansas
paras: At the heart of Wand & Whisk is our signature luxury soft serve.

Our recipe is made with real dairy and formulated at 12.5% milkfat, giving it an exceptionally rich, smooth, and creamy texture. It was developed and refined in-house, with Japan’s celebrated luxury soft-serve tradition serving as our benchmark.

As pharmacists by training, founders Jesse Pruitt and Gwendolyn Herzig understand that formulation is not a matter of guesswork. Ratios matter. Ingredients matter. Small adjustments can completely change the finished result. Our Guild Master brings that same precision and consistency to every batch we serve.

You will find our signature soft serve in taiyaki cones, dessert cups, potion floats, and seasonal guild creations. Our menu also includes Japanese-style rolled crepes, freshly made taiyaki, colorful potion sodas, and other desserts designed to taste every bit as special as they look.
softServe.closer: Taste it once, and you will understand why we call it luxury soft serve.

paras: Wand & Whisk is more than a place to get ice cream in Little Rock. It is a world of its own: warm, pastel, whimsical.

Our team members are part of the guild, our desserts have stories, and the café is filled with details meant to be discovered. It is a magical bubble where children can feel like adventurers, adults can reconnect with the things they love, and everyone is invited to stay awhile.

Whether you are planning a birthday celebration, meeting friends after a tabletop game, introducing your family to taiyaki, or treating yourself after a long day, we want your visit to feel memorable from the moment you walk through the door.

people.name: Dr. Jesse Pruitt, PharmD
paras: Jesse leads much of the creative vision behind Wand & Whisk, from its characters and storytelling to the desserts and experiences that bring its magical world to life. Outside of work, he loves to cook, collect toys and trading cards, and play video games.

Jesse studied chemistry at Arkansas State University before earning his Doctor of Pharmacy from the University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences. He and his wife, Erica, have four children: Parker, Leo, Griffin, and Freya.

people.name: Dr. Gwendolyn Herzig, PharmD
paras: Gwen brings the enthusiasm and determination that help turn ambitious ideas into places people can actually experience and enjoy. A lifelong Arkansan, she studied biology at Arkansas State University, graduated with University Honors, and earned her Doctor of Pharmacy from UAMS.
She and her wife, Beth, are the mothers of two daughters, Autumn and Evelyn.

founders.after: Jesse and Gwen first built their working partnership at Park West Pharmacy, where caring for people and creating a genuinely welcoming environment have always gone hand in hand. Together, they later created a family of locally owned Little Rock destinations celebrating imagination, play, and Japanese pop culture: Otaku Takeout, Lucky Cat Arcade, The Dojo, and Wand & Whisk Café.

people.name: Dylan Hobby, Guild Master
paras: Howdy! I’m Dylan Hobby, the Guild Master here at Wand & Whisk Cafe and a Pulaski Tech Culinary Arts graduate. Growing up watching shows like Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives and my love for theme parks both helped spark my lifelong passion for food and immersive worldbuilding. This of course led me here to help bring an immersive cafe experience to my home state of Arkansas alongside the Oni Co LLC family. When I’m not at the cafe, you can find me exploring my favorite fictional universes like Pokémon and Elden Ring, playing TCGs with my fiancé Redd, hiking the best trails the Natural State has to offer, or taking care of our pets in our home town of North Little Rock. I also LOVE music and am almost always listening to great tracks. Some of my favorite artists include Tame Impala, Daft Punk, and Glass Animals. I also have an excessive collection of flat-billed hats and food-themed Magic Cards. With a last name like mine, it is inevitable to have a lot of Hobbies.

people.name: Megan Covey, Assistant Mage
paras: Hi everyone! I'm Megan, the Assistant Mage at Wand & Whisk Café! I graduated from Colorado Technical University with an Associate's Degree in Business Administration and Management. I'm passionate about baking, a huge anime and manga fan, and enjoy spending time with my two dogs. I'm dedicated to creating a magical, welcoming experience and making every guest's visit a little sweeter.

team.members: Every member of the Wand & Whisk guild helps bring our world to life. From preparing desserts and welcoming new adventurers to keeping the café clean, colorful, and full of energy, our team is what turns the story of Wand & Whisk into a real experience.

paras: We created Wand & Whisk to give Little Rock something we wanted for our own families: a welcoming place filled with imagination, thoughtfully crafted desserts, and experiences worth remembering.
Come as you are. Bring your party. There is always room for one more adventurer at the guild.
